title: Enemy counter-development
kicker: World and empire · the war pushes back
loopLine: Farm / hunt / defend · Quests and events
hook: **Vision:** the war shifts resists and composition from **how you play** — not matched levels. Not finished / not playable yet.

blindSpots.meaning: Locked design. Do not expect the live map to hard-counter your build today.
If you lean fire, the war grows fire-hard; if you lean summons, anti-summon shows up. Rebuild follows.
The rejected idea that enemy power is only “Dave’s level ± N.” This Vision is about strategy pressure, not a level treadmill.
World events and raids that make the pushback feel alive — sibling Vision with [world events](world-events).

alsoTrue: Zomboss as a fog-bound commander already ships. Counter-development is the later “war learns your lean” layer.
Hangs on farm / hunt / defend and on world events — not a new loop heading.

sections.title: Not finished / not playable yet
paras: Play Zomboss and the map without waiting for automatic hard-counters to your aptitudes.
This page is the intended pressure curve — raise demons → a strategy works → the world counters → rebuild.

sections.title: What it is (design)
paras: Your successful leans become the world’s homework.
The answer is not inflating a level number — it is changing resists, composition, and threats so yesterday’s easy plan stops being free.
diagram: lean works  ->  world notices  ->  counters appear  ->  you rebuild

cards.name: This
cards.body: Strategy answers strategy — fire lean meets fire-hard; summon lean meets anti-summon.

groups.title: Across the war
groups.intro: When it ships, expect pressure through map threats and events — not a single toggle.
steps: Keep building and fielding as you do now.
When counters appear, read them as content — then adjust roster and plan.
Until then, treat missing hard-counters as Vision.
groups.note: Not in the current loop yet.

doTitle: What you do with this page
doSteps: Fight Zomboss and hold ground with the systems that ship today.
Do not assume the AI is broken because it does not hard-counter your lean yet.
When world events and counters arrive, rebuild on purpose — that is the fantasy.
doNote: Stop when counter ≠ level sync. Related: [Zomboss](zomboss-commander), [world events](world-events).

mixUps.q: Why isn’t the enemy hard-countering my fire team?
mixUps.a: Counter-development is Vision. Absence is expected.
No. Design rejects matched-level padding as the answer.
No. Zomboss as commander ships. This is the later ecology of counters.
No. It pressures strategy so you rebuild plans — not a prestige wipe of who you are.
